basis.joint32: 0/20 at checkpoints 030000, 060000, 090000 under identical task-0 benchmark protocol
basis.implication: runtime/evaluator can reproduce positive behavior; joint32 failure is not explained by checkpoint selection alone

static_contract_audit.comparison: recovered V3 checkpoint config vs joint32 checkpoint 030000 config
matching: MEAN_STD state/action normalization and IDENTITY visual normalization
static_contract_audit.difference: historical V3 checkpoint config has n_action_steps=50; joint32 config has n_action_steps=25; the shared audit explicitly evaluated both with n_action_steps=25, so this is a training-config difference, not an evaluator mismatch in the completed comparison
static_contract_audit.interpretation: no obvious state/action/image schema mismatch is visible in checkpoint configs; n_action_steps remains a candidate training variable but is not sufficient to explain the calibrated 0/60 result

options_compared.name: no_change
cons: does not identify or repair the training/evaluation failure

options_compared.name: inference_only_fix
options_compared.action: change state/action adapter or preprocessing without retraining
cons: no isolated evidence yet identifies one adapter defect; risks protocol drift
options_compared.decision: defer until contract audit isolates a mismatch

options_compared.name: minimal_training_contract_ablation
options_compared.action: audit and vary one contract component at a time, keeping data, seed, optimizer, steps and evaluator fixed
pros: causal and bounded; preserves calibrated evaluator
cons: requires new checkpoints and a small GPU run

options_compared.name: full_retraining
options_compared.action: restart joint32 training with broad changes
pros: may recover behavior if several issues interact
cons: expensive and uninterpretable before a minimal signal

recommended_ablation_order: freeze and record exact train/eval task language and task-id mapping
verify observation state ordering, normalization statistics and action dimensionality against the recovered V3 evaluator
verify camera preprocessing and image key/resolution contract
run one small isolated contract ablation with a fresh output directory
evaluate only on the calibrated task-0 20-init protocol before considering broader training

success_gate.primary: measurable success above 0/20 on calibrated evaluator
success_gate.secondary: improvement must replicate at a second checkpoint or independent init subset
stop_conditions: any result would require changing official evaluator
